TaskDescription: Deep brain stimulation programming. Stimulation configurations are set, tried and rated during a clinical visit, one row per configuration tried.

acq_time.Description: The entry's instant in ISO-8601 with its UTC offset (e.g. 2026-02-03T09:00:00+00:00). The only timestamp a row carries, and BIDS' own name for it: pd.to_datetime(df.acq_time) reads it offset-aware in one step. Older files that split the instant across date, time and a free-text timezone are read and folded into this column; only acq_time is ever written.

append_id.Description: Data-entry episode within this file: increments each time the file is reopened to add rows. File-scoped, so equal values in different files are unrelated. Deliberately not called session_id, which BIDS uses for the ses- label in sessions.tsv; one name for both meanings would mislead every reader of a combined table.

is_final.Description: 1 on the configuration the patient was left on at the end of the visit, as marked by the clinician; 0 elsewhere. No row is 1 when the clinician did not mark one.

is_starred.Description: 1 on a configuration the clinician starred during the visit as a particularly good one; 0 elsewhere. Any number of rows may be starred. A star records a clinical impression, not a ranking.

left_anode.Description: Left anode contact(s) in the contact grammar: case for the can, E2 for a ring, E2b for one segment, _ joining several.

left_cathode.Description: Left cathode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

left_amplitude.Description: Left amplitude in mA. A single value, or per-contact values joined by _ in left_cathode order when current is steered (3.3_2.2 is 5.5 mA split 60/40). It carries no Units because a steered value is not a single number; sum the parts for the delivered current.

right_anode.Description: Right anode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

right_cathode.Description: Right cathode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

right_amplitude.Description: Right amplitude in mA, same shape as left_amplitude.

notes.Description: Free-text note recorded with this configuration.

scale_mds_updrs_3_3_rigidity_rue.Description: One column per scale rated at this visit, placed before notes: scale_ plus the scale's name in lower case, every run of other characters turned into _ (Mood is scale_mood, MDS-UPDRS 3.10 Gait is scale_mds_updrs_3_10_gait); a second name giving the same column gains _2. The cell is the rating alone, or n/a when the scale was not assessed. The sidecar gives each column's original scale name as its LongName.
